title: acre draws mockups of a program's interface
body:
acre has drawn explanations of code, diagrams and plots. This milestone is about a different kind of figure: a still mockup of a program's interface, drawn so that Jack can judge a look before anyone changes the program. The first case is decade's chrome in two palettes, today's hand-picked colours beside colours read from the Omarchy theme. The figure lives in `figures/decade-palette.acre`.

Each child is something acre lacks for this kind of figure, found while drawing it. The figure is written by hand. When the wish for a generator script comes up, that wish marks a gap, and the gap becomes a child here.

The skill that guides these figures has a matching reference file for mockups. That file grows with this milestone.
